title: Cline Swapped the Default Model for 57 Providers
caption:
I never pinned a model. I just trusted whatever the dropdown said.

Cline 4.1.17's catalog refresh changed the resolved default model for 57 providers. Anthropic now lands on Claude Fable 5.1 instead of Claude Opus 5, and Bedrock, Vertex, OpenRouter and Vercel AI Gateway went with it.

Nothing broke. My cost line just stopped meaning what it meant last week.

Do you pin yours?
